headline: Pakistan Reduces Petrol and Diesel Prices Effective Thursday
summary: The Pakistan government reduced the price of petrol by Rs4 to Rs314 per litre and high-speed diesel by Rs5 to Rs348 per litre following OGRA recommendations.
why: Regulated retail fuel price adjustments directly impact domestic consumer inflation, transportation costs, and energy subsidies in emerging economies.

impacts.name: Pakistan
impacts.why: Lower retail fuel prices reduce consumer transportation and energy expenses.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
